notes.clause_a: MEASURED, not gated at a numeric absolute bar (stop condition, Rank 2 not prototyped). roughP95 (fragments/step-boundedness) improves vs the pre-fix reconstruction on cone/hatch/create, gated as a directional non-regression test. lenToneR2n (length-vs-tone R^2) is reported on every cell, not gated at 0.45 (Rank 1 alone reaches ~0.10-0.32, well under 0.45; Rank 2 -- a smooth spatial offset field -- is the mechanism that could move it, and it is out of this unit's scope per the plan).
notes.clause_b: STOP CONDITION 3 REACHED, disclosed. L0 stays 1.16 (unchanged from HEAD) -- dropping to 1.05 (the plan's own target, which would cut ovMax from 0.0800*R to 0.0250*R) fails the shipped O5>=2.30 bar on 4-6 of 12 fixtures (measured min ~2.19-2.23) even after sweeping MK_TICK_EASE_BLEND 0.92->0.98 (negligible recovery, ~0.005 at best, confirming T2-3's own finding that the ease curve is not an O5 lever). Per the plan's explicit ruling, shipped the re-tiling ALONE. ovMax is UNCHANGED from HEAD's own shipped 0.0800*R on every cell (retiling is exactly neutral on seam overlap by construction -- it only redistributes WHERE a tick's own length sits, never widens a single tick's L0*R ceiling). Clause (b) is NOT improved and NOT worsened.
